articles.title: Venom in His Veins
articles.summary: Bill Haast, who lived to 100, was known for surviving dozens, if not hundreds, of dangerous snakebites. Mark Hay's history recounts Haast's unique life as the long-time proprietor of a Miami establishment. His remarkable resilience and apparent immunity developed from repeated venom exposure offer insights into human limits and interaction with deadly wildlife.

articles.title: Ernie Hudson Joins Alexander Ludwig & Emma Roberts In Indie Drama ‘Hal’
articles.summary: Veteran actor Ernie Hudson has officially joined Alexander Ludwig and Emma Roberts in the cast of 'Hal,' an upcoming indie drama. The film is reportedly based on a true story. Specific plot details, character roles, or the production timeline for 'Hal' are not yet available, beyond this core casting announcement.

articles.title: NFL Draft 2026: Finding playmaking pass rushers for the Dallas Cowboys
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys experienced a significant disappointment in 2025, ranking 26th overall with merely 35 sacks. This underperformance in their defensive game is striking, especially considering the team's substantial investments and the trade involving star player Micah Parsons. The outcome fell considerably short of expectations for the franchise.

articles.title: Army chief visits White Knight Corps in Jammu, assess operational preparedness
articles.summary: Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi visited the White Knight Corps (XVI Corps) headquarters in Jammu to assess the operational preparedness of troops in the region. This high-level inspection by the Chief underscores the Indian Army's unwavering commitment to maintaining a robust defence posture and ensuring a high state of readiness, a critical aspect for national security.

articles.title: Govt starts process to procure 30 low-level light-weight radars for Army; RFP issued
articles.summary: The Indian government has begun procuring 30 low-level light-weight radars (LLLRs) to significantly bolster the Army's air-defence mechanism. These new surveillance systems are vital for detecting aerial threats at low altitudes, thereby modernizing India's military capabilities. This procurement reinforces national security by enhancing critical surveillance and response readiness against potential airborne challenges.

articles.title: The D Brief: Cost of the DC Guard mission; Shipyard reports production rise; US dronemakers in Asia; Carrier clears builder’s trials; And a bit more.
articles.summary: The deployment of the National Guard in Washington, D.C., initiated by the President, is costing US taxpayers a substantial amount. Reports indicate a daily expenditure of $1.65 million, accumulating to over $330 million since August. This significant financial outlay underscores the ongoing costs associated with maintaining enhanced security measures and public order within the nation's capital.

articles.title: Horrifying video captures massive Russian fireball in fuel tanker blast
articles.summary: A terrifying incident in Russia saw a massive fireball erupt, launching flames over 300 metres high, after petrol tanker cars on a freight train caught fire. Video footage captured the dramatic event, highlighting significant industrial safety concerns. While investigations into the cause and full impact are ongoing, this emergency underscores the critical importance of hazard management in transportation and industrial sectors globally, a key area for general awareness.
